title: MSHR (Miss Status Holding Registers)
constraints: 4 entries, each tracking one outstanding cache-line miss (`valid`, 8-bit line address).
Each rising edge: first, `resp_valid` frees entry `resp_id`. Then a `miss_valid` request is handled against the remaining valid entries:
• same line already outstanding → **secondary miss**: `merged = 1`, `merge_id` = that entry, and no memory request;
• otherwise, if an entry is free → **primary miss**: allocate the lowest free entry, `mem_req = 1` with `mem_id` and `mem_addr`;
• otherwise → `stall = 1`. All outputs are registered pulses/values for the last edge (ids and address are don't-care when their flag is 0). Synchronous reset clears all entries.
hints: Compute `v = valid & ~free_mask` first, then do an associative lookup of `miss_addr` over entries with `v[i]`.
Allocation is a priority encoder on `~v` (lowest free entry).
Merging is what makes a non-blocking cache efficient: the second access to a line that's already being fetched doesn't generate a new memory request.
